programmes.evidence: Official 2026–27 doctoral admissions policy lists the full-time DPM as PhD-awarding and names Decision Sciences and Operations Management as one of eight formal Areas of Specialization.

The same policy explicitly includes the Teaching Track among PhD-awarding doctoral programmes offered across the eight formally named specializations, including Decision Sciences and Operations Management; final research thesis and viva apply to all three tracks.
limitations: Teaching Track is a track of DPM, not a separate university or department.

programmes.evidence: The same 2026–27 policy explicitly identifies Practice Track as a PhD-awarding research doctoral programme with thesis defence and viva, offered across the formal Decision Sciences and Operations Management specialization.
limitations: Practice Track has a professional audience but the official award is a research PhD; no individual first-job inference is made.

branches.conclusion: Official 2026–27 policy inventories all three doctoral tracks and all eight academic specialization areas; one named qualifying Operations Management area is offered in each PhD-awarding track.
IIM Kozhikode's current academic and doctoral programme inventories are management-only; no engineering school or technical doctoral branch is listed by this institution.
